summary: Tested Bank Policy Master + Advanced Eligibility Check (Old CRM parity). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests PASS (CRUD, list, get, delete, eligibility check, history, auth guards). 35 seeded bank policies confirmed via API. Frontend: BankPolicyMaster page loads 35 policy cards with data-testid=policy-card-{id}, Add Lender Policy modal opens with form/bank-name-input/save-policy-btn data-testids present, EligibilityCheck page renders customer profile summary (CIBIL 736, Net Salary 45K, Current EMI 97K, FOIR 215.6%, Requested 15L, Moderate Profile). Correct categorization: 5 Eligible / 3 Possibly Eligible / 27 Not Eligible of 35 lenders. Bank Comparison table shows top banks with ROI, Tenure, Min Salary, CIBIL, BT, Top-up, Bachelor, Hostel columns. Ranking (BEST MATCH / 2ND BEST / 3RD BEST) works. Print, History, AI Parse Docs buttons visible. Missing Data warning banner shown for DOB, Present Employment Duration, Company Type.

issues: React hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper spans inserted as direct children of <select>, <option>, <table>, <tbody>, <tfoot>, <tr> — invalid HTML nesting. Caused by dev instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic tooling). Non-blocking but pollutes console and can cause hydration mismatches. Same issue also flagged in iteration_37.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning source — the <span data-ve-dynamic='true' style='display:contents'> wrappers around <tr>/<option>/<tfoot> are inserted by dev tooling and produce invalid HTML nesting. Not blocking eligibility feature.
critical_code_review_comments: bank_policies.py file is 660 lines and mixes CRUD + eligibility engine + historical aggregation — consider splitting eligibility logic into services/eligibility_engine.py for maintainability.
check_eligibility route has a nested `check_rule` closure defined inside a for-loop (created N times per policy) — refactor to module-level helper accepting mutable lists.

document_ai.py extract_document_data is a placeholder returning error='AI_NOT_CONFIGURED' — the /parse-document and /auto-parse-all endpoints return 200 with error payload rather than a proper 501/503. The frontend AI Parse Docs button will therefore silently no-op. Wire an LLM (per problem statement: AI document parsing capability) or return 501 Not Implemented until wired.
check_eligibility: eligible_amount rough multiplier `max_tenure * 0.75` is not a real EMI-to-principal conversion; use standard PV = EMI * (1-(1+r)^-n)/r formula for accuracy.
MongoDB client is instantiated at module import in both bank_policies.py and document_ai.py — should reuse the shared db client from server.py to avoid multiple connection pools.
check_eligibility inserts full check_result (including large results array) into eligibility_checks then updates the lead — no TTL/cleanup strategy; could grow unbounded.
profile.age is derived only when dob is present as YYYY-MM-DD; DD/MM/YYYY or ISO+timezone inputs are silently ignored.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 1 TEST_Bank_Iter38 policy during CRUD test. No residual data.
